note: Greenland: citizens of Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden need neither a visa nor a permit to stay and work there (Danish citizenship being Greenland's own). Greenland isn't in the EU, so EU, EEA and Swiss citizens follow the rules for all other foreign nationals: a residence and work permit from SIRI on the Government of Greenland's approval. The exemption for a stay under three months covers artists but excludes performers, restaurant musicians and similar, so no days are modelled for a performer.

sources.title: New to Denmark (SIRI), Work in Greenland
sources.said: If you are a citizen of Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway or Sweden, you neither need a visa, nor a permit to stay and work in Greenland. ... Since Greenland is not a member of the EU, the EU rules on free movement does not apply to Greenland. ... You can work in Greenland without holding a work permit if your stay is shorter than 3 months, and you are: ... a professional athlete or artist (excluding performers, restaurant musicians and similar),
